title: Egyptian Mussel Toast
description: A delicious and easy-to-make gluten-free dish featuring mussels in a spicy egyptian-inspired sauce served with crispy toast.

ingredients.name: Egyptian Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern markets

instructions: 1. Rinse the mussels under cold water and discard any broken shells.
2. In a large saucepan, heat the melted butter over medium heat.
3. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
4. Add the Egyptian Spice Blend and cook for an additional minute.
5. Add the Spicy Egyptian Sauce and bring to a simmer.
6. Add the mussels and cover the saucepan.
7. Cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the mussels are cooked through.
8. Serve the mussels over crusty toast and drizzle with lemon juice.
9. Garnish with additional Spicy Egyptian Sauce, if desired.
